primaryChecks.text: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
primaryChecks.previousContext: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文は戦利品の由来の列挙に「アマレク」を直接記すが、地理名と集団名のどちらかは明示しない。

primaryChecks.text: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 同名はエリファズの子として系譜に置かれた人物であり、場所ではない。

primaryChecks.text: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 本文が指すのは「アマレク人」の集団であり、住み着いた場所は代名詞thereで別に受ける。地名アマレクの明示用例ではない。
